purpose: Freeze the source-availability and retained/disrupted interpretation boundary for the Izu large-bumblebee pollination channel before future Issue #91 linked service outcomes are inspected. This file does not infer historical loss from floral phenotype.
functional_definition: Bombus-mediated large-bee pollination opportunity represented by source-locked Bombus diversus / Bombus ardens visitor evidence; species identity may differ between source and island while the functional channel is treated as homologous only for this bounded Izu audit.

evidence: data/two_breakpoint_evidence/inoue1986_pollinator_rates.csv: multiple positive Bombus diversus visitor-rate rows on mainland
data/two_breakpoint_evidence/inoue1990_pollinator_groups.csv: Bombus diversus reported as main pollinator in Shizuoka and Chiba
source_state.claim: A large-bumblebee pollination channel is directly supported in the mainland source context.

anti_leakage_rules: Do not use flower size, mating system, autonomous reproduction or nectar-guide phenotype to classify channel state.
Do not convert omitted Bombus rows to zero captures.
Do not call main-pollinator replacement historical extinction or island absence.
Do not use future Issue #91 reproductive outcomes to revise these source/retention definitions.
Do not transport Bombus ardens rate or effectiveness from Oshima to other islands.
next_gate: Independently establish at least one strict disrupted large-bumblebee channel unit or define a prospective contemporary retained/disrupted contrast, then link that state to effort-aware visitation, controlled SVD and effective service under the Chapter 1 H5 chain.
